facebook.caption:
This beach fixes burnout.

Bãi Trường runs for miles along Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Soft sand, warm water, and a horizon that makes your inbox feel very far away. 4.4 stars across 763 reviews. People keep coming back.

No crowds at sunrise. Just you, the waves, and a reason to put the phone down.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
